Thank you for your change.

This repository is published from WPMaven's private repository at each release, so pull requests aren't merged here: the next release would replace them.

Please describe the change in the [support forum on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/wpmaven/) instead, with a link to this pull request or to your fork. For a security issue, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/wpmaven/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
